tables.title: Standby mode
tables.text_helper: Table 60, "Standby mode", in section 8.7.7 (Standby mode) on page 241. Columns: Standby mode, Description. 4 data row(s).

rows:
WFI (wait for interrupt) or WFE (wait for event) while:
– SLEEPDEEP bit is set in Cortex-M33 system control register
– No interrupt (for WFI) or event (for WFE) pending
– LPMS=10 in PWR_PMCR
– WUFx bits cleared in PWR_WUSR

On Return from ISR while:
– SLEEPDEEP bit is set in Cortex-M33 system control register
– SLEEPONEXIT=1
– No interrupt pending
– LPMS=10 in PWR_PMCR
– WUFx bits cleared in PWR_WUSR
– RTC/TAMP flags corresponding to the chosen wake-up source, cleared
WKUPx pin edge, RTC event, external reset in NRST pin, IWDG reset
